name: ULR Contract Examples
summary: Optional independent consumers of the Ultimate Light Rail station API.
description: Optional independent Ultimate Light Rail API consumers. Requires core revision 45 or newer. Adds ULR Contract Example and ULR Component Kit Example. The component example offers Covered/Minimal surface stations with its own 20m model wrappers. The user confirmed placement at 40m/80m with/without roofs and boarding/switching in two tested variants. This is not a guarantee for every combination or external model. The main core mod does not depend on this example.
